Welcome to the Google Photos Community Support Forum!

You can check first if your Google Photos is updated to the latest version.

If it still does not work you can try to clear the cached & stored data of the Google Photos app, & then reinstall the app.
You can do that through these steps.
Tap settings on your Android phone.
Tap Apps and notifications.
Tap Show all apps.
Tap Google Google Photos
Tap Storage and cache.
Tap Clear Storage.
Next, uninstall the Google Photos app. Alternatively, roll back the app to the factory-fitted version if your phone doesn't allow you to uninstall it.
Power off the phone & then restart it.
Install the latest version of the Google Photos app through the Play Store.
However, be careful if you have activated the locked folder option. Clearing the data will remove the entire content from the locked folder & that action is irreversible. You should unlock all the pics first & then only proceed with the following steps.

The "face editing" feature may not be available in your region.

You can add a person using these steps.
 
Tap to open the photo which contains unidentified faces & then slide up or tap the three dots.

Tap the edit icon at the extreme right edge. (An icon of a pencil ).

Tap on the + sign on each thumbnail. 
The app will show you all the identified faces.
You can select the right one.
 
If not, tap the + sign at the top right corner of the screen.
That would create a new grouping.
 
Once created, the app may take some time to bring all the related pictures to this new grouping. Otherwise, you browse the collection & add the photos to the newly created group manually through the steps described above.
 
You can also create a routine album for one of them and add the photos you want.
